card.name: Contrast-agent boxed warning headings
card.fires_on: Words inside capitalized boxed-warning headings of contrast-agent labels, such as WITH after RISK ASSOCIATED, or the end of INTRATHECAL and INTRAVENOUS before USE. Also a space before a dose range for arterial injection.

modes.label: Warning heading words
modes.description: Capitalized words in boxed warnings about intrathecal or intravenous use, often WITH or the end of a route word.
modes.example: WARNING: RISK ASSOCIATED<< WITH>> INTRATHECAL USE and NE

modes.label: Route word endings
modes.description: The last piece of a route word such as INTRAMUSCULAR or INTRAVENOUS in an all-caps warning.
modes.example: WARNING - HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTIONS WITH INTRAVENOUS AND INTRAMUSC<<ULAR>> USE Fatal hypersensitivity reactions, including an

modes.label: Injection volume ranges
modes.description: The space before the upper number in a mL range for injection into an artery.
modes.example: Femoral artery: 9 mL to<< >>20 mL at 3 mL/sec

card.writes: It pushes the model toward the word contrast, as in contrast agent.
card.plain: It fires in warning headings of imaging contrast-agent labels and nudges the model toward the word contrast.
